During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Raal Yorta]] utilized a '''starship''' that was owned by his [[Raal Yorta's father|father]]. It was destroyed by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Aggressor (Imperial I-class)|''Aggressor'']] over [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="Turning" />
